352: A 6th year student in the beginning of the series, Morita occupies room 203, his floormates being Takemoto and Hasegawa. Morita is unable to graduate, as he can never wake up on time to go to classes.
353: A supremely gifted artist, Hagu's immense talents are esteemed by all who witness her works, catching the eye of numerous professional artists who insistently urge her to submit her work to exhibitions to heighten her publicity (which she seems to find daunting).
354: Yuuta Takemoto is a second-year student at the art college. He is from Annaka city, Gunma-ken. He lives in the same apartment complex as Mayama and Morita in room 202. His floormates are Morita and Hasegawa.
355: Takumi is a 4th year student at the start of the series and is from Kanazawa, Ishikawa-ken and an architecture student at the art institute. He lives in the same complex as Takemoto and Morita.
356: Yamada is well known by her peers at the art college. Due to her good looks, she also catches the attention of her male friends/coworkers at the shopping district she works with. She and Hagu seem to be very close, like siblings.
3603: Rika is the founder and manager of Harada Design; she ran it with her husband until he died in a car accident that happened on the opening night of one of the stores they designed.
3855: Shuuji is a professor at a Tokyo art university, and Hagumi's overprotective cousin.
3881: He, along with Yamazaki and Miwako, is first introduced on episode 14 of season 1. He is the type of guy who could "throw a cellphone in the sea full of women's numbers, without caring at all" as said by Mayama. Nomiya is Mayama's former boss at Fujiwara Design.
6091: Miwako is another employee at Fujiwara Design along with Nomiya and Yamazaki. She owns a dog named Leader that comes to work with her every day and more often than not will be found cuddling with or sitting in Miwako's lap.
9540: Miwako's dog, seen mostly in her presence. Although essentially a minor character, Leader exceeds his/her minor character colleagues in registering noteworthy impressions by responding when addressed and often remarking on the behavior or accounts of others.
11781: Morita's older brother who seems to have a mysterious agenda in earning ridiculously large amounts of money. It is later revealed that he and Morita are working together to buy back his father's company which was purchased by an electrical company when they were kids.
16119: A manly nurse that keeps the order trough rather violent ways in the local hostpital.
17137: Takemoto's mother. She works as a nurse. She raised him by herself for a few years following his father's death, but has since remarried.
17138: Mitsuko's second husband, Kazuo is a strong, outgoing, honest guy who tries to be a good stepfather to Takemoto.
17140: The first of the shrine repairmen that Takemoto meets, Shin is a kind, friendly guy.
17141: One of the architects at Fujiwara Designs in Honey & Clover, Yamazaki is a nice guy who somehow manages to look stylish no matter what he wears.
34888: He's the youngest one working on renovation of the temple. He's a member of team that hire Takemoto. He appears in 22 and 23 episode
37021: Shouda is another elderly teacher at the art institute that every attends, Shouda is Yamada's supervising instructor and an extremely avid admirer of her work, along with her Iron Lady fans.
